description:
Motorola Face Unlock Agent
Trust agent is a service that notifies the system about whether it believes the environment of the device is trusted.
The meaning of 'trusted' is up to the trust agent to define.
The system lockscreen listens for trust events, it can change its behaviour based on the trust state of the current user (e.g detection of a trusted face)
